required_state: Expulsion receives concurrence of at least two thirds of the relevant House.
failure_state: Expulsion concurrence is below the stated two-thirds threshold.

required_state: The relevant House keeps a Journal of its proceedings.
failure_state: The constitutionally required Journal is omitted.

required_state: The House publishes its Journal from time to time.
failure_state: The Journal is withheld without satisfaction of the source exception.

required_state: Any withheld Journal portion is one the relevant House judges to require secrecy.
failure_state: A Journal portion is withheld outside the source-defined secrecy exception.

required_state: At least one fifth of members present request entry of the yeas and nays.
failure_state: The mandatory journal-entry trigger is asserted below the one-fifth threshold.

required_state: When the threshold is satisfied, the yeas and nays are entered on the Journal.
failure_state: The threshold is satisfied but the vote is not entered on the Journal.

required_state: Adjournment for more than three days has consent of the other House.
failure_state: A House adjourns for more than three days without the other House's consent.

required_state: Adjournment to another place has consent of the other House.
failure_state: A House adjourns to another place without the other House's consent.

required_state: Senators and Representatives receive compensation for their services.
failure_state: Covered congressional service is treated as outside the source compensation entitlement.

required_state: The amount of congressional compensation is ascertained by law.
failure_state: Compensation amount lacks the source-required lawful ascertainment.

required_state: Congressional compensation is paid from the Treasury of the United States.
failure_state: A different payment source is attributed to this mechanism.

required_state: The arrest event falls within the source-defined protected attendance or travel period.
failure_state: The arrest privilege is asserted outside the source-defined protected period.

required_state: The arrest basis is not one of the source-enumerated exceptions for purposes of invoking the privilege.
failure_state: The privilege is invoked despite an expressly excepted arrest basis.

predicate_expression: if subject == COVERED_SPEECH_OR_DEBATE then questioning_place != OTHER_PLACE
required_state: Covered Speech or Debate is not used to question the member in another place.
failure_state: A member is questioned elsewhere for covered Speech or Debate.

required_state: The prohibited temporal overlap is absent unless the office condition is also absent.
failure_state: Appointment occurs during the member's elected term while the source-defined office condition exists.

required_state: The covered civil office was neither created nor increased in emoluments during the elected term.
failure_state: The office was created or its emoluments increased during the relevant term.

required_state: Covered federal officeholding and membership in either House do not coexist.
failure_state: A person simultaneously continues in a covered federal office and serves in Congress.

predicate_expression: if bill_type == REVENUE then originating_chamber == HOUSE_OF_REPRESENTATIVES
required_state: A bill for raising revenue originates in the House of Representatives.
failure_state: A revenue bill originates in another chamber.

required_state: Senate action on the revenue bill is amendment proposal or concurrence.
failure_state: The Senate treats this source as independent revenue-bill origination authority.

required_state: The House origination requirement remains satisfied.
failure_state: Senate amendment participation is used to replace the House origination requirement.

required_state: The bill has passed both Houses.
failure_state: Presentment is treated as arising without passage by both Houses.

required_state: The passed bill is presented to the President before becoming law.
failure_state: The bill is treated as law through this path without presidential presentment.

required_state: The President has approved the presented bill.
failure_state: The signature procedure is attributed to this approval path without presidential approval.

required_state: Presidential approval is followed by presidential signature.
failure_state: The President approves but the source-prescribed signature action is absent.

required_state: The veto-return pathway is entered following presidential nonapproval.
failure_state: The disapproval pathway is asserted despite presidential approval.

required_state: The disapproved bill is returned to the House in which it originated.
failure_state: The bill is returned to a different destination.

required_state: The President's objections accompany the returned bill.
failure_state: The bill is returned without the source-required objections.

required_state: The President's objections are entered at large on the originating House's Journal.
failure_state: The objections are omitted or incompletely recorded from the required Journal.

required_state: The originating House has received and recorded the presidential objections.
failure_state: Reconsideration is attributed to this sequence without the source-defined preceding veto record.

required_state: The originating House proceeds to reconsider the bill.
failure_state: The constitutional response stops without reconsideration.

required_state: The originating House has reconsidered the vetoed bill.
failure_state: Override-stage voting occurs without the source-defined reconsideration.

required_state: Two thirds of the originating House agree to pass the bill.
failure_state: The originating House override vote is below two thirds.

required_state: The bill and presidential objections are transmitted to the other House.
failure_state: The second-House stage proceeds without transmission of the bill and objections.

required_state: The other House likewise reconsiders the bill.
failure_state: The second House acts without the source-defined reconsideration.

required_state: The second House has reconsidered the vetoed bill.
failure_state: The second-House override threshold is applied without reconsideration.

required_state: Two thirds of the second House approve the bill.
failure_state: The second-House approval is below two thirds.

required_state: The bill becomes law after satisfaction of the constitutional override sequence.
failure_state: Law effect is attributed before the required override sequence is satisfied.

required_state: Both Houses determine the identified reconsideration votes by yeas and nays.
failure_state: A different vote form is used for the source-defined override votes.

required_state: Names of persons voting for and against are recorded in the respective House Journals.
failure_state: The identified voter-name record is omitted.

required_state: The President has not returned the bill within the constitutional period.
failure_state: Automatic-law effect is asserted despite timely return.

required_state: Ten days have elapsed after presentment, excluding Sundays.
failure_state: Automatic-law effect is asserted before the source-defined period expires.

required_state: Congressional adjournment does not prevent return of the bill.
failure_state: Automatic enactment is asserted despite the source-defined adjournment exception.

required_state: The action is a covered order, resolution, or vote requiring concurrence of both Houses.
failure_state: Presentment is attributed through this mechanism to an action outside the covered class.

required_state: The covered action is not a question of adjournment.
failure_state: Presidential presentment is required through this mechanism for an expressly excepted adjournment question.

required_state: The covered bicameral action is presented to the President.
failure_state: A covered action is treated as constitutionally complete without presentment.

required_state: One authorized effect path is presidential approval.
failure_state: The approval path is asserted without presidential approval.

predicate_expression: if president_approves_covered_action == FALSE then override_path_required == TRUE
required_state: Presidential disapproval moves the action to the constitutional repassage path.
failure_state: The covered action takes effect after disapproval without the required override path.

required_state: Both Houses satisfy the two-thirds repassage threshold following disapproval.
failure_state: Either House fails to satisfy the stated repassage threshold.

required_state: The override follows the rules and limitations prescribed for a bill.
failure_state: The covered action bypasses the incorporated bill rules or limitations.

required_state: The fiscal action falls within the source-enumerated taxing subjects.
failure_state: The asserted taxing authority is attributed to a subject outside the source grant.

required_state: The exercise is tied to one or more of the stated federal purposes.
failure_state: The exercise is attributed to this mechanism outside the source-stated purposes.

required_state: Covered duties, imposts, and excises are uniform throughout the United States.
failure_state: A covered duty, impost, or excise is nonuniform.

required_state: Borrowing is on the credit of the United States.
failure_state: Borrowing authority is attributed to this clause outside the identified credit source.

required_state: The regulated commerce falls within one of the source-identified domains.
failure_state: Commerce regulation is attributed to this mechanism outside those domains.

required_state: The rule concerns naturalization.
failure_state: The asserted rule is outside the source-defined subject.

required_state: The naturalization rule is uniform.
failure_state: A nonuniform rule is attributed to this constitutional power.

required_state: The law concerns bankruptcies.
failure_state: The asserted law lies outside the source-defined bankruptcy subject.

required_state: Bankruptcy law is uniform throughout the United States.
failure_state: A nonuniform bankruptcy law is attributed to this mechanism.

required_state: The exercised authority is the source-defined coining function.
failure_state: A different monetary function is attributed to this mechanism.

required_state: Value regulation concerns United States coin or foreign coin.
failure_state: Value regulation is attributed to this source outside the identified monetary subjects.

required_state: The congressional standard-setting action concerns weights or measures.
failure_state: The action is attributed to this mechanism outside the source-defined standards.

required_state: The punishment concerns counterfeiting the identified United States securities or current coin.
failure_state: Punishment authority is attributed to this mechanism outside the source-defined counterfeiting subject.

required_state: The establishment action concerns post offices or post roads.
failure_state: A different infrastructure subject is attributed to this source mechanism.

required_state: The source-defined exclusive-right mechanism is tied to promotion of progress of science and useful arts.
failure_state: The mechanism is attributed to a different constitutional purpose.

failure_state: The right is attributed through this mechanism to a different beneficiary class.

required_state: The exclusive right concerns the beneficiary's respective writing or discovery.
failure_state: The right is attributed to subject matter outside the source-defined classes.

required_state: The exclusive right is secured only for a limited time.
failure_state: An unlimited-duration right is attributed to this constitutional mechanism.

required_state: The source mechanism secures the identified exclusive right.
failure_state: A materially different right type is attributed to this mechanism.
